description:
By area + action: monitors, cohorts, web (scrape, crawl, agents, page monitors, sessions), jobs, discover, search_runs (search lists, watches), creator_runs, review_history, events (feed, webhooks). Wrong fields refused free. Managing is free; scrapes, jobs, queries, run_more/include, monitor runs bill.
